quests.instruction: Which word describes the group of children that a grandparent dotes on?
quests.question: Grandchildren
quests.hint: This is the special word grandparents use for you and your siblings.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren describes the group of children that a grandparent dotes on.
quests.funFact: Many grandparents say spending time with their grandchildren is one of life's greatest joys!

quests.instruction: Which word describes brothers and sisters as a single group term?
quests.question: Siblings
quests.hint: Instead of naming each one separately, this word covers them all at once.
quests.explanation: Siblings describes brothers and sisters as a single group term.
quests.funFact: Using the word 'siblings' is a quick way to talk about a whole group of brothers and sisters at once!

quests.instruction: Which word could include a second cousin or a great-aunt you rarely see?
quests.question: Extended Family
quests.hint: This word stretches to include more distant relatives too.
quests.explanation: Extended Family could include a second cousin or a great-aunt you rarely see.
quests.funFact: Some families hold huge reunions just to bring together their whole extended family!

quests.instruction: Which word could include a grandparent, an aunt, a cousin, or a sibling, all at once?
quests.question: Relatives
quests.hint: This is the umbrella word that covers all these different family roles.
quests.explanation: Relatives could include a grandparent, an aunt, a cousin, or a sibling, all at once.
quests.funFact: No matter how many different family roles someone has, they all count as your relatives!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the parents of your own grandparents, as a group?
quests.question: Great-Grandparents
quests.hint: This group is one generation above your grandparents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents describes the parents of your own grandparents, as a group.
quests.funFact: Meeting your great-grandparents lets you connect with family history from even further back!

quests.instruction: Which family member is part of your immediate family, not your extended family, and is a man?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: He lives with you and is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Father is part of your immediate family, not your extended family, since he is one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: Your immediate family is usually the very first group of people you learn to recognize as a baby!

quests.instruction: Which family member would one day grow up to have grandchildren of their own, just like your grandparents do?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member has their whole life still ahead of them.
quests.explanation: Baby would one day grow up to potentially have grandchildren of their own, just like your grandparents.
quests.funFact: Every grandparent in the world was once a tiny baby themselves, a long time ago!

quests.instruction: Which family member would call you and your siblings her own grandchildren?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She is one generation above your own parent, and is a woman.
quests.explanation: Grandmother would call you and your siblings her own grandchildren.
quests.funFact: Being called a grandchild by a grandmother is a warm, special family connection!

quests.instruction: Which family member is one of your relatives, specifically two generations above you and a man?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He is your mother's or father's own father.
quests.explanation: Grandfather is a relative two generations above you, and is a man.
quests.funFact: Some kids enjoy drawing their own family tree to see how each relative connects!

quests.instruction: Which family member's own siblings would be your aunts and uncles?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: Her own brothers and sisters hold a special title for you.
quests.explanation: Mother's own siblings would be your aunts and uncles.
quests.funFact: Your mother's brothers and sisters grew up with her, long before you were even born!

quests.instruction: Which word means the youngest generation shown at the bottom of a family tree?
quests.question: Grandchildren
quests.hint: This is usually the newest generation drawn on a family tree.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren often means the youngest generation shown at the bottom of a family tree.
quests.funFact: As families grow, new branches keep getting added to the bottom of a family tree!

quests.instruction: Which word means the people you likely grew up in the very same house with, other than your parents?
quests.question: Siblings
quests.hint: This word describes the children who share your home and your parents.
quests.explanation: Siblings means the people you likely grew up in the same house with, other than your parents.
quests.funFact: Many people say their siblings become some of their closest lifelong friends!

quests.instruction: Which word means your family circle stretched out to include aunts, uncles, and cousins?
quests.question: Extended Family
quests.hint: This word describes a family circle bigger than just your own household.
quests.explanation: Extended Family means your family circle stretched out to include aunts, uncles, and cousins.
quests.funFact: Extended family can grow even bigger over time through new marriages and new babies!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe an aunt, a cousin, or even a distant family member you rarely see?
quests.question: Relatives
quests.hint: This is a broad word covering many different kinds of family connections.
quests.explanation: Relatives could describe an aunt, a cousin, or even a distant family member you rarely see.
quests.funFact: Some relatives live right around the corner, while others might live on the other side of the world!

quests.instruction: Which word means your grandparents' own parents, considered together as a group?
quests.question: Great-Grandparents
quests.hint: This is the generation right before your own grandparents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents means your grandparents' own parents, considered together as a group.
quests.funFact: Family history from great-grandparents is often passed down through stories rather than photos alone!

quests.instruction: Which family member's own siblings would be your aunts and uncles, on his side of the family?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: His own brothers and sisters hold a special title for you.
quests.explanation: Father's own siblings would be your aunts and uncles, on his side of the family.
quests.funFact: Your father's brothers and sisters grew up with him, long before you were even born!

quests.instruction: Which family member is too young to understand what the word 'relatives' even means yet?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member cannot talk or understand big words yet.
quests.explanation: Baby is too young to understand what the word 'relatives' means yet, since they are the youngest family member.
quests.funFact: As a baby grows, they slowly learn who each of their family members is!

quests.instruction: Which family member is one of your relatives, specifically two generations above you and a woman?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She is your mother's or father's own mother.
quests.explanation: Grandmother is a relative two generations above you, and is a woman.
quests.funFact: Counting generations is a handy way to keep track of exactly how relatives are connected!

quests.instruction: Which family member would call you and your siblings his own grandchildren?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He is one generation above your own parent, and is a man.
quests.explanation: Grandfather would call you and your siblings his own grandchildren.
quests.funFact: Being called a grandchild by a grandfather is a warm, special family connection!

quests.instruction: Which family member is part of your immediate family, not your extended family, and is a woman?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: She lives with you and is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Mother is part of your immediate family, not your extended family, since she is one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: Immediate family usually means the people you live with every day, like your parents and siblings!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe every child born to any of a couple's own children?
quests.question: Grandchildren
quests.hint: This includes kids from every one of their children's families.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren could describe every child born to any of a couple's own children.
quests.funFact: If a grandparent has three children who each have two kids, that grandparent has six grandchildren!

quests.instruction: Which word describes brothers and sisters together, as a group?
quests.question: Siblings
quests.hint: This word works whether the group is all boys, all girls, or a mix.
quests.explanation: Siblings is the word for brothers and sisters together, as a group.
quests.funFact: The word 'sibling' is a helpful word because it works no matter how many brothers or sisters someone has!

quests.instruction: Which word means the bigger, wider version of your family, beyond your immediate household?
quests.question: Extended Family
quests.hint: This word is the wider, expanded version of your close family.
quests.explanation: Extended Family means the bigger, wider version of your family, beyond your immediate household.
quests.funFact: Learning the names of your extended family is a fun way to feel closer to your whole family tree!

quests.instruction: Which word describes anyone you are related to, no matter how the family connection works?
quests.question: Relatives
quests.hint: This word does not depend on how closely or distantly you are connected.
quests.explanation: Relatives describes anyone you are related to, no matter how the family connection works.
quests.funFact: Learning how you are connected to a relative is like solving a fun family puzzle!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe the family members who raised your grandparents?
quests.question: Great-Grandparents
quests.hint: This word describes the parents of your grandparents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents could describe the family members who raised your grandparents.
quests.funFact: Learning about how your grandparents were raised is a fun way to explore your family's past!

quests.instruction: Which word means what your grandparents call you and your siblings, together?
quests.question: Grandchildren
quests.hint: From their point of view, this is what you and your siblings are.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren means what your grandparents call you and your siblings, together.
quests.funFact: You are a grandchild to your grandparents at the very same time you are a child to your own parents!

quests.instruction: Which word means your own brothers and sisters, all together?
quests.question: Siblings
quests.hint: Think of everyone who shares your exact same parents.
quests.explanation: Siblings means your own brothers and sisters, all together.
quests.funFact: Growing up with siblings often means learning to share, take turns, and compromise!

quests.instruction: Which word describes relatives who might live in a different town or country than you?
quests.question: Extended Family
quests.hint: This word covers relatives even when there is distance between you.
quests.explanation: Extended Family describes relatives who might live in a different town or country than you.
quests.funFact: Video calls make it easier than ever to stay close with extended family who live far away!

quests.instruction: Which word means people connected to you through blood or through marriage?
quests.question: Relatives
quests.hint: This word covers both kinds of family connections.
quests.explanation: Relatives means people connected to you through blood or through marriage.
quests.funFact: When two families become connected through marriage, everyone gains a whole new set of relatives!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe up to eight different relatives, since each grandparent has two parents?
quests.question: Great-Grandparents
quests.hint: Count each of your four grandparents' own two parents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents could describe up to eight different relatives, since each grandparent has two parents.
quests.funFact: A family tree with all eight great-grandparents shown would have quite a wide branch!
